player_engagement_basis: Pinned reconstruction checks last-contact+8 >= current tick: the exclusive engine deadline is9. Its hit processor and the pinned Logout article use16 logout ticks. Home Teleport uses the source in-combat predicate, not the longer logout lock. These tick-edge mappings are explicit engineering inferences, not live measurements.
npc_engagement_basis: Bounded nonaggressive M1 NPC interpretation: use the pinned combat10-tile horizon as the source-anchor leash, the same inclusive8-contact window for inactivity/reacquisition, and the next-tick retaliation phase. Reset-to-wander is represented by returning to the source anchor without a new life, full heal or renewed loot claim. Exact roaming/leash/reset capture remains a fidelity check; no aggression or easier combat is introduced.
method_attribution_basis: Extend the existing source-supported greatest-credited-damage/earliest-contribution tie convention to per-method history. The required tutorial method guards prevent mixed melee/ranged training from satisfying the wrong lesson. This is not a claim of newly observed Jagex attribution.
death_timing_basis: Pinned PlayerDeath source waits2, begins the death animation, waits4, then transports/restores. The two source delays map to the declared Dying/Respawning phases; no instant death/reset or duplicate retention.
fresh_normal_manual_drop_basis: Items/Drop establish100/300 ordinary manual-drop ticks. Drop explicitly assigns the untradeable-item timers to accounts below20 hours of played time; Items says those timers pause offline and the items follow their owner across worlds. Bind the private300-tick fresh-normal M1 projection, not ordinary public drops. Account's10QP/100total/20hour restrictions concern trade/GE and are NOT proof of a drop-release condition. The stage-only projection after20 played hours is not source-certified and needs a playtime selector before claiming longer-lived profile parity.

fresh_normal_manual_drop_profile.acceptance_impact: A stage selector alone does not encode playtime release, offline-paused expiration or cross-world ownership. These semantics require real executor conformance, not merely matching private/expiry numbers.

npc_loot_basis: Drops explicitly gives tradeable monster loot100 private ticks and200 total ticks. Tutorial NPCs instead select the existing private50-tick Tutorial Island policy, a source-supported interpretation of the Island's ground-item rule. Ownership is the actual credited actor and source NPC life; identity/expiry are engine-owned. These are not manual-drop or death-supply origins.
unarmed_basis: Existing melee source rule explicitly gives unarmed4 ticks and the ordinary accurate/aggressive/defensive XP families. Defaults are declared, never selected from registry order.
approval_scope: All entries here remain source-supported reversible engineering interpretations. Only the separately recorded goblin potion and audio adaptations have owner-approval classifications; none of these entries inherits those approvals.
